belief_update: I believe that if people knew how much this affects me, they'd think I'm not capable of doing my job. I keep it hidden at work because I don't want to be seen as weak or unreliable. With my friend, I can say it's a rough week, but even that feels like a stretch. I don't talk about it with my parents because I know they'd overreact. Some days, I feel like this is just something my body does, not who I am. Other days, it feels like proof that I'm not good enough. I don't let anyone see how bad it gets, not even myself.
